scope: Silk lapis Cabochon icon adoption on the v7 icon branch, including the toolbar-mark derivation; no release or installed-app replacement.

design_provenance.notes: Canonical SVG adds only the tile-edge/tile-face/cabochon ids required by write_phone_icon plus a cabochon wrapper group; 256px renders are sha256-identical to the Downloads export. Regenerating the mark outputs leaves every other output hash unchanged (determinism rechecks 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-29).
design_provenance.mark_transform: write_mark_icon parses assets/lapis.svg and requires the defs block (including a feGaussianBlur with stdDeviation), the cabochon wrapper group, and the stone group's ellipse geometry; star polygon points join the ellipse bounds so rays reaching past the stone are not clipped. The frame margin is 3x the widest blur stdDeviation (3x14=42px, exp(-4.5)~1% residual falloff), and the viewBox is padded square so the mark fills the 24pt toolbar frame symmetrically; current source yields viewBox 106.0 106.0 812.0 812.0.

source_identity.method: rsvg-convert 256px renders of Downloads/lapis-silk.svg and assets/lapis.svg compared by sha256

mark_png.derivation: write_mark_icon: defs + cabochon group over a square viewBox sized to the union of stone ellipse bounds and star polygon points plus 3x the widest blur stdDeviation (viewBox 106.0 106.0 812.0 812.0)
mark_png.probe: sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight -g hasAlpha on both PNGs (48/72 RGBA); Pillow RGBA scan (alpha>8) of the published 48px and 72px rasters: content fill 0.917 of height (0.708/0.722 width), content center (0.490,0.490)/(0.493,0.493), corners (0,0,0,0), no content touching a canvas edge; 512px inspection render of the same derived SVG: fill 0.896, center (0.500,0.498), max alpha on the top edge row 0 (glow decays fully inside the frame, nothing clips)
mark_png.tool: sips and the Pillow RGBA scan above

checks.bundle_icon_reference: lapis (Info.plist.in ${MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE}; CMake installs macos/lapis.icns into Resources; filename unchanged)
visual_review: 1024 site icon: tile, bevel, dome, six slim white rays reaching the stone edge along each ray direction, silk sheen band, no clipping or banding
iOS 1024 asset: flat #1C2234 background edge to edge, no tile edge remnants, stone/star/sheen present and centered
32px decode (upscaled): tile/stone/glow hierarchy legible; ray count and sheen degrade gracefully
16px decode (upscaled): dark rounded tile, blue stone, bright star center remain readable
checks.verification_method: independent vision-model inspection of rendered outputs
